component.name: Vintyl
component.summary: Cut and draw with a vinyl cutter

description.p: Vintyl drives the popular, inexpensive drag-knife vinyl cutters (VEVOR, Seiki and the many models built on the same control board) from Linux. The knife cuts vinyl, card and paper; a pen in the holder draws on paper.

ul.li: Draw shapes and text, open SVG and DXF files, trace a picture into shapes or draw a photo with lines
Lay the design out on the sheet as the material lies in the cutter, tightly, to waste no vinyl
Knife compensation, overcut, weeding frame and lines, mirror for heat transfer vinyl, perforation
Colours drawn with several pens or cut from several colours of vinyl, one after another
Materials with their force and speed for each cutter, and a check list before every cut

description.p: The cutter is a device file: the user must be in the lp group (a USB printer) or the dialout group (a serial port) to use it.
